mapper.sql: FROM product p LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = p.category_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT pp1.* FROM product_price pp1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT product_id, MIN(id) AS min_id FROM product_price GROUP BY product_id ) first_pp ON first_pp.min_id = pp1.id ) pp ON pp.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN price_set ps ON ps.id = pp.price_set_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS total_qty FROM product_inventory GROUP BY product_id ) inv ON inv.product_id = p.id

sql.where:
p.deleted_at IS NULL
AND ( p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.search}, '%') OR c.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.search}, '%') )
AND p.category_id = #{q.categoryId}
AND COALESCE(inv.total_qty, 0) > 0

mapper.select:
SELECT p.id, p.name, c.name AS category_name, ps.name AS price_set_name, p.case_quantity, COALESCE(inv.total_qty, 0) AS items_on_hand, CASE WHEN p.case_quantity IS NOT NULL AND p.case_quantity > 0 THEN FLOOR(COALESCE(inv.total_qty, 0) / p.case_quantity) ELSE 0 END AS cases_on_hand, pp.quantity AS price_quantity, pp.id AS price_id, p.cost, pp.price
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT #{q.size} OFFSET #{q.offset}

SELECT p.id, p.name, c.name AS category_name, ps.name AS price_set_name, p.case_quantity, COALESCE(inv.total_qty, 0) AS items_on_hand, CASE WHEN p.case_quantity IS NOT NULL AND p.case_quantity > 0 THEN FLOOR(COALESCE(inv.total_qty, 0) / p.case_quantity) ELSE 0 END AS cases_on_hand, pp.quantity AS price_quantity, pp.id AS price_id, p.cost, pp.price
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC
